title: Customization
description: What to change first in a generated client project.

blocks.title: Customize first (in order)
blocks.text: 1) constants/site.ts — brand, SEO, hero copy, colors. 2) .env — database and admin credentials. 3) public/ logo and hero images. 4) Hero component if layout needs change.
Single source of truth for brand name, contact, legal text, navigation labels, hero copy, theme colors, and admin display names. Most UI strings read from SITE.*.

rows: Business name on site and admin
Canonical URL for SEO and sitemap
Admin portal title and export prefix

blocks.text: constants/default-*.ts and prisma/seed.ts provide demo rooms or listings. Re-run pnpm prisma db seed after editing defaults, or use the admin UI.
